{{Engineer infobox}}

Etienne Dorn specialises in power distributor, power plant modifications. They're reached through [[Liz Ryder]].<ref name="inara-list" />

== Location ==
* '''System:''' Los
* '''Facility:''' Kraken's Retreat
* '''Region:''' Colonia — this Engineer is only reachable after making the long journey to the Colonia region, separate from the core bubble.

== How to Discover This Engineer ==
Referral from Liz Ryder.<ref name="wanderer-chain">[https://wanderer-toolbox.com/guides/engineering-unlock/ Engineering Unlock Guide], Wanderer's Toolbox.</ref><ref name="inara-list">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineers/ Engineers], Inara.</ref>

== How to Receive an Invitation ==
Trade rank Dealer or higher.<ref name="wanderer-chain" />

== How to Unlock This Engineer ==
Unlock requirements summary:
* Have [[Liz Ryder]] unlocked and build reputation with them to trigger the referral.
* Meet the invitation requirement: trade rank Dealer or higher.
* Deliver '''25 units of Occupied Escape Pods'''.

For the complete step-by-step process, see [[Unlocking Etienne Dorn]].

== Engineer Unlock Chain ==
''No verified multi-Engineer chain to display for this Engineer.''

Etienne Dorn is reachable through [[Liz Ryder]].<ref name="wanderer-chain" />
